notes.title: Fresh Features: Shop Upgrades, Weather, Rage, and More!
notes.content:
A new update is here for you to enjoy! Check out the most important changes:

[list]
[*] Rebuy last 15 items you’ve sold at the shop anytime.
[*] Experience weather: rain, snow, and even acid rain!
[*] Build up rage in combat for extra power.
[*] Light up dark dungeons with your trusty torch.
[/list]

notes.title: Nexus Relay Launch
notes.content:
Nexus Relay is now live with a basic set of features, and more features and events will become available as chapter one continues.

Changes in this update:

[list]
[*] The stand-highlight effect has been toned down for a smoother visual experience.
[*] Nexus Relay is now live, allowing players to access its features in-game.
[*] MudGate now displays both date and time (use the date/time command).
[*] The Item-Bonus-Effects Generator has been fixed.
[*] Invalid equipment bonuses have been removed for improved balance.
[/list]

notes.content:

These are the updates for this release:

[list]
[*] Updated dungeons with improved NPC distribution.
[*] Added new NPCs to dungeons.
[*] Added a new icon for unknown objectives.
[*] The tutorial window is now fixed to the right side.
[*] Improved overall performance.
[*] Enhanced animation transitions.
[*] Added effect cleanup when changing realms.
[*] Weapon damage numbers are now displayed when combating NPCs.
[/list]

notes.title: Chromium Transition and Steam Cloud Support
notes.content:
I’ve transitioned from WebView2 to Chromium to improve compatibility. I’ve also added migration scripts to ensure your existing game data is preserved during this update. 

Additionally, Steam Cloud support has been implemented, so your progress and settings will sync across devices.

Changes in this update:

[list]
[*] MudGate World Date & Time is now set relative to March 21, 2025 (the release date).
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs did not move properly in the world.
[*] Added support for Steam Cloud.
[*] Replaced WebView2 with Chromium.
[*] Added migration scripts for existing data.
[*] Character names now allow spaces, punctuation (.-_), and accented characters.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where NPCs did not move properly in the world.

notes.title: Dungeon Visibility, Party Notifications & More
notes.content:
Here's a summary of the latest changes and improvements implemented in MudGate:

[list]
[*]   The "To the Surface" sign is now visible on all dungeon levels.
[*]   Fixed an issue where the "Invalid Use" message was sometimes displayed twice.
[*]   Parties will now be notified if a member enters a private realm.
[*]   Realm information in the log window is now only displayed when clicked.
[*]   Primal Senses has been updated:
[list]
[*]   Now hints once for nearby interactable objects.
[*]   Now provides a dexterity bonus.
[*]   Now lasts until canceled.
[*]   Now costs 1 energy per round.
[/list]
[/list]

[*] Environment Updates: Dungeons & Lowbird Forest have been updated.

[list]

[*]  Vampiric Shadows: Slightly reduced weapon siphon effects.

[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Paths Reconnected – Part 1 & 2
notes.content:
I am excited to bring you Paths Reconnected – Part 1 & 2, the latest major update in the ongoing series. This update continues to reshape the world of MudGate, introducing new terrain for exploration and restoration. 

As the world awakens, paths long lost to time have been reshaped, revealing valuable treasures. Remember, not all treasures are visible in plain sight—some may require searching and even text commands to uncover.

For a full list of all changes, please see the "Bulletins" in the MudGate Game Application.

[b]Demo hint:[/b]
Invite a guest to play on your local network in-game: "SOCIAL" -> "Create or Join Game."


[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] World Changes: New lands have been added to the following realms:
[list]
[*]  Bone Sea
[*]  Hanging Cliffs
[*]  Triset Forest
[*]  Moaning Highlands
[*]  Miserable Lands
[*]  Icemire
[*]  Lowbird Forest
[/list][*] New NPCs: Added NPCs with unique offensive and defensive abilities.
[*] New Equipment: Discover powerful new gear to aid your journey.
[*] New Player Commands:
[list]
[*] Party: Form groups with other players
[*] Wimpy: Automatically flee when health is low
[*] Flee: Manually escape from combat
[/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs would not properly interact with newly restored terrain
[*] Fixed an issue with multiplayer synchronization during public realm exploration
[*] Ghosts can no longer interact with inventory or game objects
[*] Several minor fixes to main story objectives
[*] Minor tweaks to improve playability and UI
[/list]

[h2]Technical Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game files are now created temporarily and moved instead of being saved over the current file
[*] Updated the web renderer to Babylon.js v7.50.0
[/list]

[b]Enjoy the new adventures, and happy exploring![/b]
